# Mansoor Khan Academy

> Mansoor Khan Academy is an independent developer brand from Pakistan, run by Mansoor Khan, that builds free Android apps and tools for content creators.

Contact: mansoorkhan8185@gmail.com

## Apps

- [Prompt Book: AI Video Prompts](https://promptbookapp.github.io/): Free Android app with ready-to-use prompts for AI video and image generators. Pick a niche, copy a prompt, paste it into your AI tool. Package: com.mkhanacademy.promptbookapp. Currently in Google Play early access: join https://groups.google.com/g/mansoor-app-testers then open https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.mkhanacademy.promptbookapp
- [YouTube channel](https://www.youtube.com/@PromptBookOfficial): Short videos made from Prompt Book prompts.
